UEFA backs Diallo to challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency

UEFA has endorsed France's candidate, Diallo, to run against Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. The election is scheduled to take place at the FIFA Congress on March 18 of the following year. UEFA had reportedly been seeking a strong contender to oppose Infantino.
